newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro started.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said it had started coverage of Mexico's Grupo Radio Centro SA with a rating of attractive.
-- "We like the company for its tight cost structure and dominant position in Mexico City," analysts Carlos Laboy and Hector Tassinari wrote in a report dated Wednesday.
-- "Grupo Radio Centro will, in our view, be a leading beneficiary of a pickup in Mexican consumer spending when the domestic economy reactivates."
-- The company has "the infrastructure ... to sustain a significant expansion in revenues and earnings without the need for important capital investments.
-- "... Our 12-month target price is $9.36 (per American Depositary Receipt), which represents a 25 percent return from current levels."
-- The company's shares closed at 7-1/4 on Wednesday in New York.
